items.headline: Coding Agents Are Guessing: Measuring Action-Boundary Violations in Underspecified DevOps Instructions
items.summary:
arXiv:2607.02294v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM coding agents are increasingly deployed to act autonomously on real production infrastructure. They execute shell commands, modify repositories, and call operational APIs. However, completing a task is not sufficient for safety. A wrong action can cause severe consequences.
